items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: I thought he was going to Gene Krupa, right there by Kelly Stable. I told him. I said, I'm going to see how much music he knows. So he looked at me and said, Nat, I said, what's the matter, Gene? He said, I don't read.

ctx.x: And you see, baby dots, 45 angle, you've never seen kick his drum like that.

Baby dot tell you, when you kick a drum, the tune, it's so fast, it's so close to get a, it cause a rumble in the bass drum. pop, when you hit that, boom, and then, psss, psss, psss, psss, psss, psss, psss, psss, Man, that boy, and under you, never had that loud drum like Gene Krupa.

Gene Krupa jumped on the bandstand when he was with Benny Goodman. He thought he could kill David Allen. I said, babe, people looked at him like he was crazy. Two people applaud him. The same Gene Krupa. Gene Krupa don't know nothing about music. He can't read, huh?
